<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="17" x2="322" y2="21" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="14" x2="327" y2="21" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="11" x2="332" y2="21" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="8" x2="337" y2="21" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="16" x2="354" y2="16" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="10" width="19" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="366" y="13" width="12" height="6" rx="1" fill="#001B94"/>
    <line x1="383" y1="14" x2="383" y2="18" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="25,61 17,69 25,77" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="40" y="75" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">Check-in</text>
    <circle cx="337" cy="68" r="20" fill="#001B94"/>
    <text x="337" y="76" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter Black, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="900" fill="#FFFFFF">P</text>
    <circle cx="375" cy="48" r="4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="371" y1="59" x2="379" y2="59" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="371" y1="64" x2="379" y2="64" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="371" y1="69" x2="379" y2="69" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="105" width="350" height="86" rx="20" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="20" y="103" width="350" height="86" rx="20" fill="#E2EEF5"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="145" r="22" fill="#001B94"/>
    <text x="54" y="153" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">6E</text>
    <text x="88" y="137" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">Ready to fly?</text>
    <text x="88" y="158" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Check in online and save time at the airport.</text>
    <text x="88" y="174" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Have your booking details handy.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Segmented airline selector -->
  <g>
    <text x="25" y="220" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">SELECT AIRLINE</text>
    <rect x="25" y="232" width="170" height="34" rx="15" fill="#001B94"/>
    <text x="110" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">IndiGo 6E</text>
    <rect x="195" y="232" width="170" height="34" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="280" y="254" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#C2C2C2">Other airline</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Form -->
  <g>
    <text x="25" y="303" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">BOOKING REFERENCE</text>
    <rect x="25" y="312" width="340" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="45" y="346" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1A1A1A">6E7K2P</text>
    <text x="45" y="386" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#A5A5A5">Enter your 6-character PNR</text>

    <text x="25" y="430" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">EMAIL OR LAST NAME</text>
    <rect x="25" y="439" width="340" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="45" y="473" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#C2C2C2">Email address or surname</text>
    <text x="45" y="513" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#A5A5A5">Use the details from your reservation</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Search button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="139" y="548" width="116" height="34" rx="20" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="137" y="546" width="116" height="34" rx="20" fill="#001B94"/>
    <circle cx="159" cy="563" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="163.5" y1="567.5" x2="168" y2="572" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="206" y="568" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#FFFFFF">Search booking</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Support note -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="619" r="10" fill="#E2EEF5"/>
    <text x="31" y="623" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#001B94">i</text>
    <text x="49" y="617" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Online check-in opens 48 hours before departure</text>
    <text x="49" y="633" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">and closes 60 minutes before your flight.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="755" width="390" height="89" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="756" x2="330" y2="756" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="38,785 51,774 64,785" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="784" width="18" height="15" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Home</text>
    
    <!-- Book -->
    <rect x="130" y="777" width="27" height="22" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="784" x2="157" y2="784" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="136" y1="773" x2="136" y2="781" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="151" y1="773" x2="151" y2="781" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="143" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Book</text>
    
    <!-- Flight status -->
    <ellipse cx="242" cy="786" rx="15" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="242" y1="786" x2="242" y2="778" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="242" y1="786" x2="249" y2="790" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="242" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#5E5E5E">Flight Status</text>
    
    <!-- Check-in active -->
    <rect x="316" y="776" width="27" height="22" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="321,787 327,793 338,781" fill="none" stroke="#001B94" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="329" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Anderson Grotesk Ultrabold, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#001B94">Check-in</text>
  </g>
</svg>
